title: Finite affine covering descent with auxiliary factorizations
statement: Let $I$ be a nonempty directed preorder, $D:I^{op}\to\mathrm{Scheme}$ a diagram of quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes with affine transitions, and $c$ a limit cone with apex $X$ and projections $p_j$. Fix $i_0\in I$, an affine étale object $W$ over $D(i_0)$ [def-weil-pbc-full-affine-etale-site], and $n\in\mathbb N$. Let $V_q$ be affine étale objects over $X$ with a covering family $a_q:V_q\to p_{i_0}^*W$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. For each $q$ fix an arbitrary étale object $U_q$ over $D(i_0)$ and an arrow $b_q:V_q\to p_{i_0}^*U_q$. There exist $j\in\mathrm{Over}(op\,i_0)$, affine étale objects $V_{j,q}$ over $D(j)$, a covering family $a_{j,q}:V_{j,q}\to f_j^*W$, arrows $b_{j,q}:V_{j,q}\to f_j^*U_q$, and isomorphisms $d_q:p_j^*V_{j,q}\cong V_q$. For the canonical iterated-pullback isomorphism $e_j(Z):p_{i_0}^*Z\cong p_j^*f_j^*Z$, the equations $p_j^*a_{j,q}\circ e_j(W)^{-1}=d_q\circ a_q$ and $p_j^*b_{j,q}\circ e_j(U_q)^{-1}=d_q\circ b_q$ hold, with composition written in diagrammatic order. This assertion contains no sheaf or section.

proof.text: Apply simultaneous source and two-arrow descent, without a covering assertion, to obtain j,Vj,aj,bj,d and both arrow equations.

Transfer the original covering to the family Bj(aj) by the source isomorphisms d and the target comparison e_j(W), using the first arrow equation. Coverings are jointly surjective by Scheme.ofArrows_mem_smallEtaleTopology_iff.

Lift canonical pullback functors to the full affine etale categories using affineness of the transition and cone maps. Their first projections are natural and give the defining pullback squares. Convert the limit sieve covering to the finite precoverage, apply Scheme.affineEtale_covering_eventually, then convert its jointly surjective family back to the canonical sieve covering. This applies also to n=0.

Transport both families of arrows and their source comparisons to this stage, using the proved factorization-data base-change theorem. Its formula for ak and the target isomorphism transfer the canonical covering to ak. Affineness is preserved by pullback along an affine transition. This gives the required witnesses, cover, affineness and both equations.

theorem etale_finiteCoverFactorizationDescent
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)] [Nonempty I]
    (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u})
    [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, CompactSpace (D.obj i)]
    [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, QuasiSeparatedSpace (D.obj i)]
    [∀ {i j : Iᵒᵖ} (a : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map a)]
    (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit c) (i₀ : I)
    (W : (D.obj (op i₀)).FullAffineEtale)
    (n : ℕ) (V : Fin n → c.pt.Etale)
    (a : ∀ q, V q ⟶
      (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ (c.π.app (op i₀))).obj W.obj)
    (U : Fin n → (D.obj (op i₀)).Etale)
    (b : ∀ q, V q ⟶
      (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ (c.π.app (op i₀))).obj (U q))
    (ha : Sieve.ofArrows V a ∈ c.pt.smallEtaleTopology
      ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ (c.π.app (op i₀))).obj W.obj))
    (hV : ∀ q, IsAffine (V q).left) :
    let B := fun j : Over (op i₀) ↦ MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ (c.π.app j.left)
    let F := fun j : Over (op i₀) ↦ MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ (D.map j.hom)
    let e := fun (j : Over (op i₀)) (Z : (D.obj (op i₀)).Etale) ↦
      (MorphismProperty.Over.pullbackComp (P := @Etale) (Q := ⊤)
        (c.π.app j.left) (D.map j.hom) (c.π.app (op i₀)) (c.w j.hom).symm).app Z
    ∃ (j : Over (op i₀)) (Vj : Fin n → (D.obj j.left).Etale)
      (aj : ∀ q, Vj q ⟶ (F j).obj W.obj)
      (bj : ∀ q, Vj q ⟶ (F j).obj (U q))
      (d : ∀ q, (B j).obj (Vj q) ≅ V q),
      Sieve.ofArrows Vj aj ∈ (D.obj j.left).smallEtaleTopology ((F j).obj W.obj) ∧
      (∀ q, IsAffine (Vj q).left) ∧
      (∀ q, (B j).map (aj q) ≫ (e j W.obj).inv = (d q).hom ≫ a q) ∧
      (∀ q, (B j).map (bj q) ≫ (e j (U q)).inv = (d q).hom ≫ b q)
